note: Reference data copied from the named sources as read on 2026-11-16. Tolerances were written before any comparison was run and must not be changed to make a case pass. The tolerances are the author's choice, not an industry standard.

tableCd.why: Applied Ballistics prints Cd to two decimals, so a match is within half a unit of the last printed digit.

velocityPct.why: Manufacturer tables print whole fps; 1% of about 2400 fps is about 24 fps.

dropIn.why: Larger of 2% or 0.3 in, since tables print drop to 0.1 in.

tablePoints.source: Applied Ballistics, ABDOC130 Drag Curve Models
tablePoints.quote: At Mach 3 (3348 fps) the G1 projectile has a drag coefficient of 0.51, while the G7 projectile has a drag coefficient of only 0.24.

tablePoints.source: Applied Ballistics, ABDOC130 Drag Curve Models

trajectoryCases.source: Hornady Law Enforcement product page, 6.5 Creedmoor 140 gr OTM-A, item 81480
inputsNotPublished: sight height beyond the -1.5 muzzle row

assumptions.why: ICAO standard atmosphere, which Hornady states its BCs are corrected to (https://www.hornady.com/bc). Sight height from the published muzzle row.

confirmed_distances.zeroNote: Not stated by Hornady. Inferred from the published trajectory of 0 at 100 yd with a -1.5 in muzzle row.

rowNotes.50: The page text for the 50 yd column returned 0 / N/A / 0. The owner judged this a missing or placeholder entry, not a ballistic value. Preserved as invalid and not compared.

labelsConfirmed.confirmedBy: project owner, by viewing the page directly

trajectoryCases.valuePairing: Corrected 2026-11-16 19:04 by the project owner: the 50 yd column is a placeholder (0 / N/A / 0), and 2553 fps belongs to 100 yd. The triples were read from the page by a page-reading tool and the owner supplied the corrected pairing. The transcription the owner refers to was not seen by the author. Each row's energy is checked against its velocity in tests/validation.test.js as a transcription check; that check does not test ballistics. The pairing is the owner's, and has not been confirmed row by row against the page by the author.

A_shifted_one_column.reason: Used 2026-11-16 18:41 to 18:56. Paired 2553 fps with 50 yd, which shifted every row one column. The 50 yd column is a placeholder. Corrected by the project owner at 19:04.

B_hundred_yard_steps.reason: Discarded by the owner at 18:41 under the label '100-yard steps', before the 50 yd placeholder was identified. Its numbers are identical to the current mapping. The current mapping was adopted because the owner's page evidence (the placeholder 50 yd column) supports it, not because it matches the engine. Kept as history only.

ICAO.source: https://www.hornady.com/bc states BCs are corrected to the ICAO standard atmosphere (59 F, 29.92 inHg, 0% RH), as read by a summarizing page reader.

HORNADY_ABERDEEN.source: Hornady External Ballistics page quotes 'standard conditions for the Aberdeen test site': sea level, 59 F, 29.53 inHg, 78% RH, as read by a summarizing page reader.

atmosphereNote: Hornady's own pages disagree on which standard atmosphere its BCs use. Both are declared here before any dataset was run. Every dataset is run under each applicable atmosphere, both results are reported, and neither is selected as correct. STATED_CONDITIONS means the dataset's own printed conditions, used only where the source prints them.
preRegistration: Datasets, interpretations, atmospheres and tolerances below were written before the first run of tests/tools/run-validation.js on them (2026-11-16, after the 21:02 request). Tolerances are unchanged from the original three.

datasets.source: Gold Medal Berger 6.5 Creedmoor 130 gr Berger AR Hybrid OTM, part GM65CRDBH130

cellNotes.100: The Average Range 100 yd trajectory cell is an image placeholder (symbol.gif) with no value. It is left null and not inferred as 0.
cellNotes.400: Average Range table stops at 300 yd.
cellNotes.500: Average Range table stops at 300 yd.

excludedTables.Long Range trajectory: Excluded. Its zero range is not stated (the caption says zeroed at 100 yd but the 100 yd value is +1.6 in, so the caption does not describe this table), and its 200 yd cell is a placeholder.
excludedTables.Wind drift at 10 mph: Not compared. The heading has no values on the page as read, and the crosswind model is a separate question.

datasets.pairingNote: Read by a page-reading tool, not seen by the author. Tables are labeled Muzzle/100/200/300/400/500 Y (velocity, energy) and 50/100/200/300 Y (Average Range). The 130 gr and 2875 fps figures reproduce the printed energies (energy check in tests). A second person has not reproduced this copy.

datasets.note: Printed BC 0.241. A round-nose bullet fits the G1 shape poorly, so a larger difference here would say something about G1 BC use, not necessarily about the engine.

energyCheckExceptions.50: Printed energy 3139 ft-lb; 2803 fps at 180 gr gives 3141.1, a 2.05 ft-lb gap, just over the 2 ft-lb check. Not corrected. It may be a typo in the source or in the page read. Only the velocity and drop are compared, never the energy, so this does not enter any comparison.
